visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman in a white tank top stands in a bright kitchen, performing rhythmic arm movements while ingredients like vegetables and rice balls are spread out on the table before her. (2) Close-up shots transition quickly between different rice ball dishes, showing savory meat fillings, peanut, and sesame textures under bright studio-style lighting. (3) A young boy holds a small black microphone while standing between the young woman and an older woman in a pink shirt; they are looking at a scoring board with various text categories. (4) The older woman is shown cooking in a kitchen, adding ingredients to a pot while holding a package of branded rice balls and gesturing. (5) A man wearing a white mask and a wave-patterned t-shirt holds a cucumber and gestures towards the camera in an animated fashion. (6) Visuals of cooking continue with a pan-fried rice ball patty and boiling water in a black pot; yellow and white variety-style text overlays appear frequently. (7) The younger and older women interact in the kitchen, gesturing towards food items and speaking with expressive facial movements and hand gestures. (8) The masked man and the younger woman stand together in a well-lit living area, with the man holding up two fingers while talking. (9) The older woman sits on a sofa in a living room, giving a double thumbs-up with a wide smile towards the camera. (10) The entire group gathers around the kitchen table, with the young woman holding a recording device to the boy's face while he makes an expectant facial expression.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Challenge Introduction -> Cooking Process -> Family Interaction -> Conclusion/Reaction
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional challenge for Laurel (桂冠) rice balls, specifically showcasing the versatility of their savory and sweet products. By framing the product showcase within a fun, fast-paced family cooking competition, it highlights ease of use and family togetherness while appealing to social media trends.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Prominent display of branded Laurel packaging, explicit verbal and textual product mentions, and the entire narrative structured as a brand-led challenge.
